description: HYDRUS is a software family for simulation of water, heat and solute transport in variably saturated porous media. The provider lists specialist modules for wetlands, geochemistry, particle transport and other subsurface applications. The resource is documented by PC-Progress. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. The suite and the separate free HYDRUS-1D product have different access conditions. The public page does not establish a licence for the whole suite; do not infer that every module is free. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied.
